fusions.name: Breaking Bolt
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt of arcane force that deals 36 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignores resistances and leaves it [Spell Impetus] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Latticed Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 4 bolts at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Mirror Gate
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is returned to whoever dealt it. You have 12% more arcane resistance while it holds.

fusions.name: Quickened Ward
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner, and your arcane resistance rises by 12%.
